full_judgment: 34. Moreover, it is surprising to note that Monir Hossain though cited as witness in the charge sheet has not been examined by the prosecution giving rise to the presumption under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act in that had he been examined he would have not supported the prosecution case. Thus, we find that as a whole the prosecution miserably failed to prove the case against the appellant beyond all reasonable doubt to the hilt.
